subject.title: fix(whatsapp): suppress typing for unmentioned group runs regardless of delivery mode

question: Should WhatsApp solve silent unmentioned group typing with this narrow `suppressTyping` predicate, or should this wait for the broader visible-delivery send-start design?
rationale: Both paths address the false typing signal, but the narrow path intentionally removes the typing flash from rare proactive visible replies while the broader path expands lifecycle/API surface.

options.title: Refresh The Narrow Mitigation
options.body: Rebase this PR onto current main, adapt the predicate to the current context shape, and accept the no-typing tradeoff for proactive unmentioned visible replies.

options.title: Prefer The Structural Send Boundary
options.body: Use the broader visible-delivery design after its conflicts and API compatibility review are resolved, then close this PR as superseded.

options.title: Defer Until Live Repro Returns
options.body: Keep current behavior until a live WhatsApp/model reproduction proves the automatic-delivery false typing path is active again.

recommendation.title: Refresh The Narrow Mitigation
recommendation.body: Rebase this PR onto current main, adapt the predicate to the current context shape, and accept the no-typing tradeoff for proactive unmentioned visible replies.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the overlapping visible-delivery PR and have recent merged WhatsApp inbound-dispatch history, making them the best routing candidate for the narrow-versus-structural choice.
